Aker Solutions responsible for all work, including Civil 1 work, except civil design and construction of new jetty. 2.1.3 ABOUT PORT TAMPA BAY Port Tampa Bay is the largest port in the State of Florida and is supervised by the Tampa Port Authority. The port is primarily located in the city of Tampa, Florida, though some of the port property resides outside city limits and is administered by Hillsborough County. The port directly accesses Tampa Bay on the west coast of Florida and is approximately 30 miles from the Gulf of Mexico. The port serves containerships, tankers, and cruise ships among its primary maritime customers. As of 2023 year-end data, Port Tampa Bay ranks 24th in the U.S. in total trade in cargo tonnage. It is the largest and most diverse port in Florida with an economic impact of more than $15.1 billion and supports more than 80,000 jobs3. As a result, Port Tampa Bay is well qualified to support the T-RICH project. It has an in-house engineering staff with extensive experience assisting terminal development involving liquid cargoes including petroleum, natural gas, and ammonia products. Its capabilities include providing engineering, business development, and regulatory expertise related to new terminal tenants. Moreover, it has adopted a forward-looking approach to sustainability and fully supports the emerging cargo of liquified CO .
